description: 150rpm gear system - full formula set (motor + per-gear-stage template + disturbance + combining). 'constants' are cyan-highlighted terms swept under BVS (Bounded Value Sweep); 'state_variables' evolve at runtime and are never swept.

motor.label: Tesla (DC Motor) Equations
motor.note: Cyan = constants under BVS (R, L, Ke, Kt, Jmotor, b, T_static). Everything else (V, i, ω, T, T_load) is a state variable, not swept.

gear_template.label: Single Gear Stage Equations (repeated per gear stage)

formulas.label: Speed relation
formulas.implemented_in: dynamic_gear_simulator.py (theta_gap definition inside _mesh_torque; not used by formula_chain_metal.run_formula_chain, which uses the equivalent RPM-chain ratio instead)

formulas.label: Reflected inertia
formulas.implemented_in: dynamic_gear_simulator.py: build_gear_train() -> reflected_inertia_at_motor_kgm2 (generalized to cumulative N across multiple hops back to Yellow); informational output only, not used by the node-by-node integration, which tracks each node's own physical inertia

formulas.label: Backlash (dead-zone)
formulas.formula: θgap = θin - θout;  Tmesh = 0 if |θgap| < θbacklash

gear_template.note: Cyan = constants under BVS (N, η, Jgear, θbacklash, kmesh, bshaft). ω, θ, T stay state variables. This template repeats once per gear stage in the chain. As of dynamic_gear_simulator.py, all six formulas are implemented as a real time-domain (RK4) simulation, exposed via POST /api/gearsystem/touch_sim_dynamic -- separate from formula_chain_metal.run_formula_chain(), the steady-state snapshot used by the BVS card-roulette sweep, which still ignores backlash/stiffness/reflected-inertia entirely (see FORMULA_DATABASE.md sec G and Open Item #2).

formulas.label: External disturbance (touch/screwdriver), injected at whichever gear node is touched
formulas.notes: P is the 0-10 pressure metric; ktouch is the force-per-unit-pressure constant (under BVS).

formulas.label: Total load felt by the motor (sums every gear stage's reflected effect back to the shaft; plugs into Tload in motor_3)
formulas.notes: No new cyan constants here - it just chains the per-gear outputs (already covered) back to one number.
